lines.en: Esther, not everyone who watches that series likes it, but everyone I know keeps talking about the finale.
lines.pt: Esther, nem todo mundo que assiste àquela série gosta dela, mas todo mundo que eu conheço só fala do final.

lines.en: Most people I work with loved it, though a few said the plot was too slow in the middle.
lines.pt: A maioria das pessoas com quem trabalho adorou, embora algumas tenham dito que o enredo ficou lento demais no meio.

lines.en: Some of them probably gave up early. Anyone who stays until episode five usually gets hooked.
lines.pt: Alguns provavelmente desistiram cedo. Quem fica até o episódio cinco geralmente se vicia.

lines.en: True. The people who complained were mostly the ones who expected constant action.
lines.pt: Verdade. As pessoas que reclamaram eram, na maioria, as que esperavam ação constante.

lines.en: Neither of my brothers enjoyed it, which surprised me, because both of them love crime stories.
lines.pt: Nenhum dos meus irmãos gostou, o que me surpreendeu, porque os dois adoram histórias policiais.

lines.en: Maybe the characters who disappear in the middle annoyed them. Nobody likes losing a favourite character.
lines.pt: Talvez os personagens que somem no meio tenham irritado. Ninguém gosta de perder um personagem favorito.

lines.en: Possible. Each episode I saw had something clever, and every scene felt carefully planned.
lines.pt: Possível. Cada episódio que vi tinha algo inteligente, e toda cena parecia cuidadosamente planejada.

lines.en: I agree, but a lot of viewers who write online reviews only care about the ending, and few of them forgive a weak one.
lines.pt: Concordo, mas muitos espectadores que escrevem avaliações online só se importam com o final, e poucos perdoam um fraco.

lines.en: Most of the critics I read were fair. Several praised the writing, while a few found it confusing.
lines.pt: A maioria dos críticos que li foi justa. Vários elogiaram o roteiro, enquanto alguns acharam confuso.

lines.en: Well, all of us in the living room last night were silent for ten minutes after the last scene.
lines.pt: Bem, todos nós na sala ontem à noite ficamos em silêncio por dez minutos depois da última cena.

lines.en: That says everything. Whoever made it knew what they wanted, and plenty of people respect that, even if they disagree.
lines.pt: Isso diz tudo. Quem fez sabia o que queria, e muita gente respeita isso, mesmo discordando.

facts.big: everyone who, most of, a few, neither of
facts.label: Opiniões divididas
facts.sub: Not everyone who watches it likes it. Most people loved it. A few found it confusing. Neither of my brothers enjoyed it.

facts.label: who, which
facts.sub: Use who para pessoas e which para coisas: People who complained left. A series which has a weak ending disappoints fans. Em português: “que”. Pode usar that em orações definidoras.

facts.label: most, a few, several
facts.sub: Most people loved it. A few found it confusing. Several praised it. Com substantivos plurais, use most, many, a few, several; com incontáveis, use much e a little.

items.why: We say most people or most of the people.

answers: Everyone takes a singular verb. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Most of people”. → Falso (We say most people or most of the people.)
Neither of my brothers is followed by a singular verb in careful Engl… → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Opinions about a series · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday night in Atlanta. Cal and Luisa sit in a cosy living room. The last episode has just finished. The screen goes dark, but nobody moves. Both of them have strong opinions. Cal turns off the lamp and begins to talk.

“Luisa, not everyone who watches that series likes it, but everyone I know keeps talking about the finale.” says Cal. “Most people I work with loved it, though a few said the plot was too slow in the middle.” says Luisa. “Some of them probably gave up early. Anyone who stays until episode five usually gets hooked.” says Cal.
